name: 84084 · West Jordan, UT
findings: ZIP 84084 (West Jordan) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84084 (West Jordan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84084 (West Jordan) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).
